entries.category_description: Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
entries.code_description: Licensing services of other printed matter
entries.comment: The transfer of intellectual property rights according to Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXIX, 1° with the exception of the supply of advertising services (59.11.3) and the transfer and licensing of intellectual property rights on computer programs (58.29.50). The reduced rate only applies to 58.11.6, 58.12.3, 58.14.4, 58.19.30, 59.13.11, 59.20, 60.10.12, 60.2, 74.3, 77.40.1 in that context.
